question: In India, poverty estimations are based on surveys conducted by the National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO). Under which ministry does the NSSO function?

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The method commonly used by the National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO) of India to collect information is known as Survey or Sampling method.
 
• They use stratified sampling techniques to gather information on a variety of socioeconomic parameters across the vast demographics of India.
 
• The NSSO conduct large-scale sample surveys throughout India.
 
• The employees of the NSSO are from the Indian Statistical Service (appointed through the UPSC) and the Subordinate Statistical Service (appointed through the Staff Selection Commission).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The main divisions of NSSO are:

 
 
• Survey design and research division- headquarters located in Kolkota.
 
• Field's operation division- Headquarters located in Delhi/Faridabad.
 
• Data Processing division- Headquarters in Kolkata.
 
• Coordination and publication division- Headquarters in Delhi.
